summary: ØRSTED A/S (LEI W9NG6WMZIYEU8VEDOG48, Danish CVR 36213728) is identifier-confirmed and registered in Denmark. The Ministry of Finance on behalf of the Kingdom of Denmark holds a shareholding in the company, with Wikidata indicatively reporting that stake at 50.1% (sourced from the 2019 annual report); additional indicative shareholdings are reported for Andel Energy (7.28%), Goldman Sachs (13.0%), and Capital Group Companies (6.0%), all sourced from Wikidata and to be treated as indicative only. GLEIF records a reporting exception for the ultimate parent, meaning the parent entity is identified but does not consolidate ØRSTED A/S, leaving the ultimate beneficial ownership chain partially opaque; this opacity, combined with an ownership structure of three or more corporate layers, raises structural risk signals (medium confidence) around opaque ownership and complex layering, with a low-confidence advisory signal regarding possible obfuscation that requires confirmation of legitimate economic rationale. A related entity, HORNSEA 1 LIMITED, returns name matches in both the Panama Papers and Bahamas Leaks databases (ICIJ score 88/100, medium confidence each), which are structural indicators for further review and not determinations of wrongdoing. Multiple board members and officers — including Andrew Richard Dingley Brown (næstformand), Karl Johnny Hersvik, Julia Elizabeth King, Julian David Waldron, Trond Ødegård Westlie, Rasmus Errboe, Benny Gøbel, and Ruchit Majmudar — share names with records on the Denmark, Faroe Islands and Greenland PEPs list via OpenAleph, though all are possible name matches only with no birth date or nationality confirmed, and each requires individual verification. OpenSanctions data used in this review is licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0 and may not be commercially re-used without a separate licence.
